title: Voices, surround sound and new models
notes: Voices: Wren, HALCYON and the courier now speak their radio lines out loud (your system's text to speech), each with their own voice. The ending is read out too. Turn it off or set its volume in Settings.
Surround sound: enemy shots, their charge-up before firing, bullets whizzing past, charger footsteps, impacts and kills come from where they happen. Best on headphones; switch it off in Settings.

Every model rebuilt: armoured wardens with helmets, visors and shoulder plates, a hooded long-rifle sniper, a riot-shield warden, a hunched blade-armed charger, rotor drones, twin-barrel turrets, crystal pylons and a new HALCYON core with an iris.
The wardens move now: they aim at you, recoil when they fire, breathe while they wait and run on two legs.
Your gun, blade and gloved hands rebuilt, with a glowing edge that flares when you cut.

title: Every controller, and phones
notes: Controllers: Xbox, PlayStation (DualShock 4 and DualSense), Steam Deck and the Steam Controller all work, in Chrome, Edge and Firefox, with or without Steam running.
Button names follow the pad you are holding: A / B / LB / RT on Xbox, ✕ / ○ / L1 / R2 on PlayStation, L1 / R2 on Steam Deck. Wren's tips use them too.
Vibration on pads that support it, a little aim help on sticks, and menus you can drive with the D-pad.
Phones and tablets: a thumb stick, drag to look, and buttons for jump, slide, dash, fire, blade and focus. Play it sideways.
Settings: controller vibration on or off, touch look speed.

title: Release
notes: A new game: a first-person parkour shooter in a drowned neon megacity. HALCYON is opening the sea gates at dawn. Climb the Spire and stop it.
Run the walls, slide under pipes, dash and double-jump. One hit kills you, and one hit kills them, but you're straight back at the last checkpoint.
A gun with six shots and a blade that cuts wardens down and sends their bullets back at them. Hold Q to slow time.
Six chapters with a story over the radio, a boss at the top of the Spire, times and ranks for every chapter.
Controller support, settings, achievements and ☁ Sync between your devices.
